The '''Akwin Net Gun''' was a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]-like variant of [[Net gun/Legends|net gun]] utilized by the [[Akwin]], an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. It fired metal mesh [[Net/Legends|nets]] that restrained and stunned their victims with an electric shock. Each gun carried two nets.<ref name="TSoK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Akwin Net Gun was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
